description: Shrake-Rupley solvent accessibility of free AHSP (PDB 1W09) mapped onto NES-like matches and basic residues
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

txt=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1W09.pdb",timeout=60).text   # NMR, FREE AHSP
# take MODEL 1 only
lines=txt.split("\n")
m1=[];inm=False
for l in lines:
    if l.startswith("MODEL"):
        inm = (int(l.split()[1])==1)
    elif l.startswith("ENDMDL"):
        if inm: break
    elif inm and l.startswith("ATOM"):
        m1.append(l)
if not m1:
    m1=[l for l in lines if l.startswith("ATOM")]
print("atoms in model 1:", len(m1))

AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLU':'E','GLN':'Q','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
     'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
     'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'H':1.20}
xyz=[];rad=[];res=[];elem=[]
for l in m1:
    if l[76:78].strip()=='H' or l[12:16].strip().startswith('H'): continue
    e=l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0]
    if e not in VDW: continue
    xyz.append([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    rad.append(VDW[e]); res.append((int(l[22:26]), l[17:20].strip())); elem.append(e)
xyz=np.array(xyz); rad=np.array(rad)
print("heavy atoms:", len(xyz))

# ---- Shrake-Rupley SASA ----
def sphere_points(n=960):
    i=np.arange(n)+0.5
    phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); theta=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    return np.c_[np.cos(theta)*np.sin(phi), np.sin(theta)*np.sin(phi), np.cos(phi)]
SP=sphere_points(960)
probe=1.4
R=rad+probe
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
tree=cKDTree(xyz)
sasa=np.zeros(len(xyz))
maxr=R.max()
for i in range(len(xyz)):
    nb=tree.query_ball_point(xyz[i], R[i]+maxr)
    nb=[j for j in nb if j!=i]
    pts=xyz[i]+R[i]*SP
    acc=np.ones(len(SP),bool)
    for j in nb:
        d2=((pts-xyz[j])**2).sum(1)
        acc &= d2 > R[j]**2
    sasa[i]=4*np.pi*R[i]**2*acc.mean()

dfa=pd.DataFrame({'resi':[r[0] for r in res],'resn':[r[1] for r in res],'sasa':sasa})
per=dfa.groupby(['resi','resn'],as_index=False)['sasa'].sum()
# Tien et al. 2013 theoretical max ASA (Gly-X-Gly)
MAXASA={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'E':223,'Q':225,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,
        'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
per['aa']=per['resn'].map(AA3)
per['rsa']=100*per['sasa']/per['aa'].map(MAXASA)
per=per.sort_values('resi').reset_index(drop=True)
print("\nmean RSA = %.1f%%  (n=%d residues)"%(per.rsa.mean(),len(per)))

HEL={'H1':(4,24),'H2':(33,56),'H3':(62,90)}
def helix(i):
    for k,(a,b) in HEL.items():
        if a<=i<=b: return k
    return 'loop/term'
per['elem']=per['resi'].map(helix)

# NES candidates from the regex scan
cands={'NES-cand-1 (11-20) ISAGLKEFSV':list(range(11,21)),
       'NES-cand-2 (37-47) MVTVVEDWMNF':list(range(37,48))}
PHI=set("LIVFM")
print("\n=== Solvent accessibility of hydrophobic (Phi) residues in the loose NES matches (free AHSP, PDB 1W09 model 1) ===")
rows=[]
for lab,rng in cands.items():
    sub=per[per.resi.isin(rng)]
    phi=sub[sub.aa.isin(PHI)]
    print(f"\n{lab}  secondary structure: {sorted(set(sub.elem))}")
    print(sub[['resi','aa','sasa','rsa','elem']].round(1).to_string(index=False))
    rows.append(dict(candidate=lab, n_phi=len(phi), mean_RSA_phi=round(phi.rsa.mean(),1),
                     max_RSA_phi=round(phi.rsa.max(),1),
                     n_phi_buried_RSA_lt20=int((phi.rsa<20).sum()),
                     secondary_structure=",".join(sorted(set(sub.elem)))))
summ=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n", summ.to_string(index=False))
summ.to_csv("ahsp_NES_accessibility.csv",index=False)
per.to_csv("ahsp_1W09_rsa.csv",index=False)

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,7),sharex=True,gridspec_kw=dict(height_ratios=[2,1]))
cols=['#4C78A8' if a not in PHI else '#E45756' for a in per.aa]
ax[0].bar(per.resi,per.rsa,color=cols,width=0.85)
ax[0].axhline(20,ls='--',c='k',lw=1)
ax[0].text(1,22,'RSA 20% (buried threshold)',fontsize=8)
for k,(a,b) in HEL.items():
    ax[0].axvspan(a-0.5,b+0.5,color='grey',alpha=0.12)
    ax[0].text((a+b)/2,105,k,ha='center',fontsize=9)
for lab,rng in cands.items():
    ax[0].plot([rng[0],rng[-1]],[-6,-6],lw=4,c='#F58518')
    ax[0].text((rng[0]+rng[-1])/2,-13,lab.split(' ')[1],ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#F58518')
ax[0].set_ylabel('relative solvent accessibility (%)')
ax[0].set_title('Human AHSP (PDB 1W09, free protein, model 1): no NLS, and the leucine-rich\n'
                'NES-like matches sit in buried helix cores (red = L/I/V/F/M)')
ax[0].set_ylim(-16,112)
chg=np.where(per.aa.isin(list('KR')),1,np.where(per.aa.isin(list('DE')),-1,0))
ax[1].bar(per.resi,chg,color=np.where(chg>0,'#54A24B','#B279A2'),width=0.85)
ax[1].set_ylabel('charge'); ax[1].set_xlabel('AHSP residue number')
ax[1].set_yticks([-1,0,1]); ax[1].set_yticklabels(['D/E','','K/R'])
ax[1].set_title('No contiguous basic patch: longest K/R run = %d'%max(len(x) for x in re.findall(r'[KR]+',
                "MALLKANKDLISAGLKEFSVLLNQQVFNDPLVSEEDMVTVVEDWMNFYINYYRQQVTGEPQERDKALQELRQELNTLANPFLAKYRDFLKSHELPSHPPPSS")),fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
